name: @mgamadeus/ddd-web
description: TypeScript web client for backends built with mgamadeus/ddd, the DDD entity framework for Symfony and Doctrine (Composer/Packagist). Generates a typed RTK Query SDK from the backend's OpenAPI document, builds DDD QueryOptions (filters, orderBy, expand, select, paging) and handles JWT auth with token refresh.
author: Marius-Eugen Gerdan <marius@gerdan.net>
